summary: This bill reforms the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA) by prohibiting warrantless queries of U.S. persons' communications, limiting directives to certain electronic communication service providers, expanding the use of amici curiae in FISA Court proceedings, and extending FISA Title VII authorities, while also preventing law enforcement and intelligence agencies from purchasing certain commercially available data and limiting civil immunity for providing assistance to the government without a court order.
